figures.caption: Transimpedance loop gain over five process corners, by \texttt{stb} through the \texttt{IPRB\_F} probe. $R_f = \SI{560}{\kilo\ohm}$, $C_f = \SI{22}{\pico\farad}$, electrode \texttt{randles\_cell} with $R_s = \SI{100}{\ohm}$, $R_{\mathrm{ct}} = \SI{1}{\mega\ohm}$, $C_{\mathrm{dl}} = \SI{100}{\nano\farad}$, \SI{25}{\celsius}. DC loop gain \SIrange{76.5}{78.0}{\decibel}, crossover \SIrange{6.3}{6.7}{\kilo\hertz}.
Loop phase for the runs of Figure~\ref{fig:tia-cl-loopgain}. Phase at crossover is the phase margin in this convention, \SIrange{61.2}{64.9}{\degree}.

Closed-loop transimpedance magnitude over five process corners, conditions as Figure~\ref{fig:tia-cl-loopgain}. Peaking \SIrange{1.2}{1.5}{\decibel} at \SI{3.98}{\kilo\hertz}; \SI{-3}{\decibel} bandwidth \SIrange{7.2}{7.5}{\kilo\hertz}. At $C_f = \SI{5}{\pico\farad}$ the same conditions give \SIrange{3.0}{3.7}{\decibel} of peaking and \SIrange{41.7}{46.4}{\degree} of phase margin.

tables.caption: Transimpedance loop stability by process corner. $R_f = \SI{560}{\kilo\ohm}$, $C_f = \SI{22}{\pico\farad}$, electrode \texttt{randles\_cell} with $R_s = \SI{100}{\ohm}$, $R_{\mathrm{ct}} = \SI{1}{\mega\ohm}$, $C_{\mathrm{dl}} = \SI{100}{\nano\farad}$, \SI{25}{\celsius}. Schematic-level, no extracted parasitics, with an ideal feedback resistor in place of the 16-tap string. DC loop gain at $R_{\mathrm{ct}} = \SI{10}{\kilo\ohm}$ is \SIrange{41.9}{44.3}{\decibel} under otherwise identical conditions.

Closed-loop transimpedance by process corner, conditions as Table~\ref{tab:tia-cl-stability}. Transimpedance at \SI{1}{\hertz} is within \SI{0.02}{\percent} of $R_f$, which is an ideal element in this measurement.
